sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.class_symbol_id AS symbol_id FROM code.class_ancestry a JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = a.ancestor_symbol_id WHERE a.ancestor_symbol_id = 'httpx/_exceptions.py::RequestError' AND a.class_symbol_id <> a.ancestor_symbol_id ORDER BY symbol_id
